dim_station.title: Weather Stations
dim_station.desc: INMET station metadata used for Rondônia's climatology: code, name, latitude and longitude.

health_climate_daily.title: Daily Health & Climate
health_climate_daily.desc: Daily series of deaths in climate-sensitive groups and climate variables (temperature, precipitation, humidity) per municipality in Rondônia, 2018–2023.

heatwave_events.title: Heatwave Events
heatwave_events.desc: Heatwave events detected at RO's INMET stations (WHO/WMO methods), with duration, severity, and intensity class.

health_climate_distributed_lag.title: Health & Climate — Lag Matrix
health_climate_distributed_lag.desc: Health-climate series with 21-day lagged exposure history, input for lagged-risk modeling (DLNM).

dlnm_exposure_response.title: DLNM — Risk vs. Temperature
dlnm_exposure_response.desc: Cumulative relative risk curve as a function of temperature, per state, DLNM model output.

dlnm_lag_response.title: DLNM — Risk vs. Lag
dlnm_lag_response.desc: Relative risk effect by lag day (0 to 21 days), at the 75th percentile temperature, per state.

dlnm_surface.title: DLNM — Risk Surface
dlnm_surface.desc: Two-dimensional relative risk surface (temperature x lag), per state.

env_era5_daily.title: Gridded Climate — ERA5-Land
env_era5_daily.desc: Daily temperature and precipitation per municipality from the ERA5-Land reanalysis (ECMWF), complementary to INMET.

env_chirps_daily.title: Gridded Rainfall — CHIRPS
env_chirps_daily.desc: Daily precipitation per municipality from CHIRPS v2.0 (satellite + station data, ~5km).

env_prodes_daily.title: Deforestation — PRODES
env_prodes_daily.desc: Annual deforested area per municipality across the 6 biomes monitored by PRODES/INPE.

env_pollution_cams_daily.title: Air Pollution — CAMS
env_pollution_cams_daily.desc: Daily PM2.5 and PM10 concentration per municipality, CAMS (Copernicus) reanalysis.
